name: caspule-nfsim-polymer
description: CASPULE bond-aware MD coupled to NFSim rule-based kinetics for a polymer fractionation experiment. Type-1 monomers polymerize into branched clusters on a 6x6x6 lattice; each atom can carry up to 4 bonds. The ObservableDetector applies three size-based rules: dimers (size 2) and trimers (size 3) are extracted from the spatial pool and injected into NFSim as distinct molecule types; polymers (size 4+) are observed but kept in the spatial pool so the bond network remains visible. NFSim then integrates distinct decay kinetics for each molecule class (dimers activate quickly, trimers slowly, polymers degrade slowly). This composite demonstrates multi-rule detection and multi-species coupling across spatial and non-spatial simulation regimes.

config.input_script:
units lj
atom_style bond
boundary p p p
neighbor 0.5 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes
region box block 0 6 0 6 0 6
create_box 1 box bond/types 1 extra/bond/per/atom 4 extra/special/per/atom 50
mass 1 1.0
lattice sc 1.6
create_atoms 1 box
pair_style soft 2.0
pair_coeff * * 30.0
bond_style harmonic
bond_coeff 1 5.0 1.5
minimize 1e-4 1e-4 100 100
fix nve all nve/limit 0.05
fix lan all langevin 0.4 0.4 1.0 12345
timestep 0.005
fix mkbnd all bond/create 10 1 1 1.8 1 iparam 4 1 jparam 4 1
thermo 5

config.model_string:
begin parameters
    init_Dimer    0
    init_Trimer   0
    init_Polymer  0
    init_Active   0
    k_dimer_act   0.30
    k_trimer_act  0.05
    k_polymer_dec 0.02
    k_active_dec  0.05
end parameters
begin molecule types
    Dimer()
    Trimer()
    Polymer()
    Active()
    Decay()
end molecule types
begin seed species
    Dimer()    init_Dimer
    Trimer()   init_Trimer
    Polymer()  init_Polymer
    Active()   init_Active
end seed species
begin observables
    Molecules Dimer    Dimer()
    Molecules Trimer   Trimer()
    Molecules Polymer  Polymer()
    Molecules Active   Active()
end observables
begin reaction rules
    Dimer()   -> Active()    k_dimer_act
    Trimer()  -> Active()    k_trimer_act
    Active()  -> Decay()     k_active_dec
    Polymer() -> Decay()     k_polymer_dec
end reaction rules
